metadata.case_name: SO KIM LUNG v. LEE PAK WAI

source: The Plaintiff suffered minor injury to soft issue on his lower back and neck at the accident. There was no external wound or bone fracture. There was also no neurological deficit. His complaints made to both the Family Medicine Department and the Orthopaedic Department of the Tuen Mun Hospital was exaggerated, and as a result certain sick leaves were granted to him unnecessarily. Thereafter, however, there is still a 0.5% residual mild pain and ache at his neck and lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level
